mapper.sql: cvr.id, cvr.company_id, cu.company_name, cvr.visit_date, cvr.remark, cvr.creator_teacher_id, creator.teacher_user_id AS creator_teacher_account, creator.name AS creator_teacher_name, cvr.create_time, cvr.update_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM company_visit_record cvr JOIN company_users cu ON cu.id = cvr.company_id JOIN teacher_users creator ON creator.id = cvr.creator_teacher_id WHERE cvr.id = #{id}
mapper.sql: cvp.id, cvp.visit_record_id, cvp.teacher_id, tu.teacher_user_id AS teacher_account, tu.name AS teacher_name, tu.phone AS teacher_phone, cvp.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT FROM company_visit_participant cvp JOIN teacher_users tu ON tu.id = cvp.teacher_id WHERE cvp.visit_record_id = #{visitRecordId} ORDER BY tu.name ASC, cvp.id ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO company_visit_record (company_id, visit_date, remark, creator_teacher_id, create_time, update_time) VALUES (#{companyId}, #{visitDate}, #{remark}, #{creatorTeacherId}, #{createTime}, #{updateTime})

INSERT INTO company_visit_participant (visit_record_id, teacher_id, create_time) VALUES
(#{participant.visitRecordId}, #{participant.teacherId}, #{participant.createTime})
